Problem Statement:
Insertion sort is the sorting mechanism where the sorted array is built having one item at a time. The array elements are compared with each other sequentially and then arranged simultaneously in some particular order.You have to sort the given array of integer values in insertion sort manner.
input_spec: Given an integer 'n' which indicates the length of array and next line followed by space separated ‘n’ integer values.Where 1
